subject: Thank you Alex for applying to Acme
snippet: Thank you for applying for the Junior Developer role at Acme. We have received your application.
body:
Hi Alex,
Thank you for applying for the Junior Developer role at Acme. We have received your application and our recruitment team will now review your CV and experience against the requirements of the role. This usually takes up to two weeks, and we read every application ourselves rather than relying on automated screening.
We will contact you by email about the next stage.
If this particular role isn't the right fit, keep an eye on our careers page for future openings.
Best regards,
Acme Talent Team
